messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — ran the FP8 baseline on the instr-following eval (subset: 2k prompts). At ~1.8x throughput improvement but saw a systematic drop on factual QA: F1 down ~6 points and hallucination rate up ~3.5%. Logs attached (snippet).

sam: Can you paste the eval histogram? Which layers did we quantize? int8 vs fp8?

maya: We quantized matmuls in MLP and attention projection to FP8 (blockwise), left LN & embeddings in FP32. Config:

```yaml
quant:
  dtype: fp8_e4m3
  scope: per-tensor
  excluded_ops: ['layer_norm', 'embedding']
  clip_threshold: 6.0
```

maya: The dropout of exactness seems correlated with prompts that rely on long-range factual grounding (long-context retrieval). Short prompts fine.

li: Interesting — did you enable per-channel scaling or do we have global scales? Per-tensor might be hurting headwise sensitivity.

maya: Per-tensor. Per-channel is tricky for fused kernels on current runtime but we can prototype.

zach: Replied for ops: if we enable per-channel we might lose the current kernel fastpath. Tradeoff: perf drop ~15% vs accuracy regains of ~3pts maybe. Need telemetry to show when to enable it.

rebecca: Suggest adding a "degeneration_signal" metric in runtime: combine per-request delta in logprob for top tokens + token-coverage mismatch vs FP32 baseline. Could surface as alert when > threshold.

maya: Agree. Sample metric:

```
deg_signal = mean_neg_logprob_diff_over_topk(20) + lambda * (unique_tokens_diff)
```

sam: Also let's add prompt-class tagging: "retrieval", "math", "conversational" so we can slice impact. Put into eval harness.

ops-bot: perf_alert: rolling canary scheduled: fp8-probe -> ramp 5% -> 3h -> monitor deg_signal & latency. (react:eyes)

li: For fallback, propose layered policy: if deg_signal > T1 -> switch to per-channel fp8; if > T2 -> fallback to int8; if > T3 -> fall back to fp32. Need hysteresis to avoid flapping.

zach: Hysteresis and cost model important: fallback to fp32 for 1% requests could blow costs. Maybe instead implement "graceful degrade" path: reroute only requests with tag "high-fidelity" to fp32; others to int8.

maya: Agree on tagging. For immediate action items:
- add per-prompt tags to eval harness (sam) — due EOD
- add deg_signal telemetry on canary (rebecca + li) — due tomorrow
- prototype per-channel kernel microbenchmark (li) — due next week
- define fallback cost thresholds & hysteresis (zach + finance) — week

rebecca: I'll add dashboard tiles: deg_signal percentile, FP8 vs FP32 delta hist, request tags slice.

sam: One more: consider small calibration set for per-workload clipping constants instead of global clip_threshold. Could reduce hallucinations.

maya: OK thanks — I'll hold the FP8 ramp until we have the telemetry. If someone else wants to try per-channel quick patch ping me.

deploy-bot: canary started: fp8-probe @ 5% (id: c-3623456789). Monitoring deg_signal, latency, mem. (react:rocket)
